The '''Edorian Itassi''' was a plant that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Its roots could be crushed into powder to produce [[shadowpaw]], a drug smoked by the native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] during spiritual ceremonies.<ref name="SWG:Shadowpaw">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Shadowpaw}}</ref>
